title: Find files with SUID or SGID bits set
summary: List all executable files on the system that have the Setuid (SUID) or Setgid (SGID) bit. These files run with elevated privileges and are common targets for privilege escalation attacks.

steps.explain: Search the entire filesystem for files with the SUID or SGID bit set. Errors from inaccessible directories are suppressed.
